description: Inside a vaulted stone hall with a gallery of onlookers, a tricolour banner (red, white and green vertical bands with a laurel-wreathed emblem) is unfurled from the balcony rail. Below, men in dark 18th-century coats and tricorn hats raise their arms and face the flag, with a speaker at a wooden lectern in the centre, and light falls through a high window.
